title: Static current-KL 262k-to-1M multi-seed scale
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: The independently confirmed positive 65k-to-262k slopes will continue through one million cumulative physical hands in at least two seeds while preserving both-seat multi-anchor breadth and Standard10 capability.
material_change: Exact-state continuation of all three frozen 262k lineages to at least 1048576 cumulative physical hands with repaired monotonic pool candidate identities, preserved optimizer/replay/league/assignment state, static current-to-Standard10 KL, and disjoint fixed deal streams.
baseline: Across 294912 frozen prior-plus-fresh evaluation hands, all three 65k-to-262k slopes were positive (+1.054,+0.613,+0.780 bb/100) and seeds2/3 passed both-seat three-anchor breadth; pooled +0.816 CI95 [-1.526,+3.157].
notes: Preflight passed 26/26 tests. Final training audit passed all three lineages and session-independence with 2357804 new and 3152810 cumulative physical environment hands. The first audit exposed an audit-only accounting assumption: interrupted workers had 1516 and 2844 completed terminal tails beyond the last committed metric at seed3 recovery boundaries. Each next session's metric rows prove a constant inherited physical prefix (482697 and 761075 respectively); the audit now records and verifies these carried tails rather than incorrectly requiring session_completed_hands to start at the last committed metric. Frozen weights and raw training evidence were not altered.

Untouched evaluation completed 98304 physical matched hands. Seed slopes were -1.9379, +0.3113, and +2.9341 bb/100; combined +0.4358 CI95 [-3.0908,+3.9625]. Median slope was positive and 2/3 seeds positive, but only seed3 qualified both-seat and at-least-three-anchor breadth. All 60k outcome-blind Standard10 drift states passed; max mean TV 0.01095 and max greedy disagreement 0.01255.

result.summary: Three exact-state static current-KL lineages reached at least one million cumulative physical environment hands with full recovery/accounting integrity; frozen matched evaluation found a small positive combined 262k-to-1M slope but mixed seed/anchor breadth.
result.conclusion: The method is mechanically sound and has positive median and 2-of-3 seed slopes, with no catastrophic Standard10 drift or replicated broad reversal. It misses the preregistered promotion rule because only one seed preserves broad both-seat multi-anchor improvement, so the evidence is insufficient rather than a long-horizon rejection.
result.next_step: Before spending another multi-million-hand tranche, run a zero-new-Slumbot, outcome-aware but label-free attribution study over existing raw external cohorts and counterfactually validate any replicated state-class vulnerability using internal matched simulation or solver targets. Use that evidence to choose between targeted general resampling/value calibration and continued larger-scale static-KL training.
